// diagnostic

E2421

Public fallible function `{function}` exposes non-public failure carrier member `{member}`.

What

Public fallible function `{function}` exposes non-public failure carrier member `{member}`.

Why

The public failure contract makes `{member}` part of the callable's visible carrier, but its declaration is not public.

Fix

Make `{member}` public, or keep `{function}` non-public.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2421: tests/ui/e2421_public_failure_carrier.stderr.
